history.resolved: The ancient foe of an old and noble house — the lost soul leads to him (Arc H).

sunsword.resolved: In an amber prison where the devil fears to tread; the house of the fallen dragon can lead you there.

deadlines.label: Arabelle's nameday — toy at the Vistani camp by noon
deadlines.note: Madam Eva's request from the Tarokka reading. Buy at Blinsky Toys, deliver to the camp SW of Vallaki. No celebration happens while she's still missing (Arc E).
